description: The same sign-in flow with the checklist docked in a column of its own: the page is laid out beside the panel instead of underneath it, so a 1920x1080 frame is one 16:9 composition — app on the left, list on the right, nothing covered. The panel's heading carries a second line saying what the list is for.

steps.name: open the sign-in page
steps.caption: Open the sign-in page for your workspace.

steps.name: the form is on screen
steps.caption: Sign in with the address and password you already use.

steps.name: fill the email
steps.caption: Type the email address on your account.

steps.name: the workspace is on screen
steps.caption: You land in your workspace, signed in.
